Nice to meet you. I'd like to make a request. ────────────────────────────────────── 【Character to be Depicted】 Kurenai Haruna
【Appearing Work】 Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story 【Theme】 Please depict two expressions for the [Character to be Depicted]: a "gentle expression" and a "mean expression," similar to the characters appearing in the TV anime "Gnosis." 【Specifications】 The depiction should range from the top of the head (from the horns if present) to the bust.
────────────────────────────────────── Example) ・Image 1: Yuna-chan with a soft/gentle expression, as depicted previously. Reference URL: https://x.com/katsuonoeboebo/status/1997306642451615861

・Second illustration: Based on the first illustration, using the [attached reference URL] (time stamp 1:09–1:12) as a guide, depict Yuna-chan with a dark overall color palette, glowing red eyes, an open mouth, and a protruding tongue—essentially her "evil" expression. This is a variation. Supplemental Notes: All unspecified details—scene/background, clothing, posture, expression, etc.—are entirely at your discretion.
────────────────────────────────────── That's all. Thank you for your cooperation.

[Attachment URL] https://youtu.be/8UO5su3pjB4?si=iWuOSGBi-0KeHxWT&t=69 (Time-specific) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8UO5su3pjB4 (No time specification)

Thank you very much for all your help. This time, I would like you to draw a full-body drawing of an anthropomorphic Double Wild Mouse-chan (idol costume, petit-range ver. [sleeveless]) from Nagashima Spa Land. I would like her to have a smiling expression with both eyes open and her mouth open as usual. Double Wild Mouse-chan is 15 years old.


The scene should be the morning before the opening of Nagashima Spa Land, when Double Wild Mouse (Idol Costume: Petit Arrange ver. [Sleeveless]) is looking at the rainbow after the rain has gone down.


I would like her to be standing in front of me with her whole body from her head to her shoes and the whole costume visible. If possible, please pose her in a way that her arms and legs are not hidden. Also, just in case it is raining, please draw Double Wild Mouse without an umbrella or any other object, and with both hands empty-handed.


If you don't mind, I would be happy to use your illustration as an X icon or header, or to post or spread your illustration with your name on it, or download or take a screenshot of your illustration. I would be happy to use your illustration in my good morning post if you would like to use it.


Thank you very much.
